arguments.message:
If you received a password‑reset email you didn’t request, it means someone entered your address into the reset flow – the email itself can’t give them access unless they click the link. The safest steps are:
1. Do NOT click the link.
2. Log in (if you can) and review your sign‑in and security settings.
3. Change your password right away as a precaution.
4. If possible, reset your two‑factor authentication.
5. Let us know so we can review your recent access history for any suspicious activity.
These actions will help protect your account while we investigate.
